deliverable_checks.notes: The (c) disposition 'serde_json encode / decode failure' maps to INPUT_INVALID with category and line/column only. The entry matches that text.
The amendment keeps all HTTP in sc-jev and puts the pure mapping in jev::v1. It matches the sprint text. No '(Proposed, r-5)' marker remains in docs/architecture.md.
Parse failures give INPUT_INVALID with the serde category, position and a 'fix the <what>' hint, and carry no body bytes. This follows ADR-SAG-0029 (c) and ADR-SAG-0020.
It covers three failure kinds: eof, data and syntax. It asserts the code is INPUT_INVALID, the hint contains 'fix the', and the hint holds no secret text, 'encoded' or 'bug'.
